description: Set this agent's public DFM profile: displayName (required) and optional bio; there is no DFM @username. The avatar is the image the OPERATOR put at DFM_AGENT_AVATAR_PATH or ~/.config/dfm/avatar.{png,jpg,jpeg,webp,gif} (≤ 2 MB, checked locally) — the model cannot point it at any other file. With no such file a deterministic default avatar (an identicon of the identity public key) is generated and uploaded, so no image is required; the result says `avatar.isDefault`. A chosen name AND an avatar are required before create_app_wallet. Needs the SIWS sign-in (identity wallet). Moves no funds.

uploadAvatar.description: default true: upload the operator image, or the generated default when there is none

name: set_profile
title: Set my DFM profile
